## Chart Generator Template

This README.md documents how to setup the RAM charts MCP container
for use in SAS Retrieval Agent Manager (RAM). It uses the MCP container found here: <TODO: link to pkgs in github>

This MCP container was forked from the MCP Server chart container(https://github.com/antvis/mcp-server-chart) and modified to return base64 encoded images as the tool output, rather than
hosting the generate images in an external URL.

**IMPORTANT:** To view the images generated by this tool server, you will need to use an agent
code template that renders the base64 images. See the [image render agent](../../agents/image_render_agent/) example for how to
create such a template.

### Template Settings (required fields)

- Container image: TODO
- Arguments: --transport sse --port 3000
- Transport: Server-Sent Events
- Port: 3000
- Base Path: /sse

### Authentication

No authentication is required.

### Environment Variables

No environment variables are required.

### Configuration File

Leave this file empty.
